layout.evaluation_step: excluded; evaluation belongs to the experimental protocol

spacing.shared_offline: ID training images; frozen classifier and L2 normalization; class-specific GMMD reference model
spacing.shared_inference: method-specific group input; frozen classifier and L2 normalization; one shared set of normalized query features
spacing.shared_reference: light-blue boxes denote reuse of the same class-specific GMMD reference model in both scoring paths
spacing.gmmd_central: combine normalized features before Gaussian group-mean scoring; one OOD score for the input group
spacing.gmmd_mean: align the image-level scoring path with the common inference flow, then average the scores; one OOD score for the input group
